component.name: arvdownloader
component.summary: Modern cross-platform Video, Reels, Shorts, Playlist and MP3 Downloader

description.p: arvdownloader is a fast, modern GTK4 and Libadwaita desktop application for downloading videos, Reels, Shorts, Playlists, and high-quality MP3/M4A audio across Linux and Windows.

Features include interactive playlist selection, dedicated playlist folders, automatic browser cookie integration, managed Deno JS runtime support, and self-updating yt-dlp and FFmpeg engines powered by libsoup3.
